messages:
rachel_csm: HelioMaps asks for a short-lived config change for a partner demo tomorrow. Request: pin to us-west-2, allowlist 198.51.100.100/32, and bump QPS on /v1/generate by 1.6x for 2 hours. This demo will feed into renewal talks. Can infra assist?

tom_support: Need org id, exact window, and whether to auto-revoke. Also confirm route scope (org-wide vs route-only).

HelioMaps_OPS: Org: org_heliomaps_9. Window: 2025-07-10T15:00:00Z -> 2025-07-10T17:00:00Z. Auto-revoke: yes. Route-only: /v1/generate only. CIDR: 198.51.100.100/32. Contact: infra@heliomaps.ai.

oncall_anya: Plan: 1) add ACL entry, 2) region pin org_heliomaps_9 -> us-west-2 (fallback allowed), 3) set per-route qps_override=1.6, 4) schedule revoke. Tagging @sean_eng for quick IP check.

sean_eng: IP looks fine. Approve ACL and 1.6x QPS. Suggest limiting concurrent embeddings if they start embeddings jobs later.

tom_support: I'll stage then push. Staging command:

```bash
redwoodctl orgs patch-policy --org org_heliomaps_9 --patch '{"region_pin":"us-west-2","routes":{"/v1/generate":{"qps_override":1.6}},"acls":["198.51.100.100/32"]}' --region us-west-2 --expires 2025-07-10T17:00:00Z
```

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch start_time=2025-07-09T20:05:12Z actor=tom_support status=queued

deploy-bot: action=policy.patch actor=tom_support status=success time=2025-07-09T20:06:21Z ref=patch-98211

oncall_anya: Verified ACL + region pin + qps override are live in us-west-2. Auto-revoke scheduled at 2025-07-10T17:00:00Z. I'll monitor p95 and errors during the window and report any anomalies.

HelioMaps_OPS: Warmup looks good. If demo converts we'll want a follow-up on Dedicated pricing and SLA options.

rachel_csm: Noted  added to renewal tracker and will schedule a follow-up if the demo goes well. Thanks team :thumbsup:
